# phare_uptime_heartbeat (Resource)

Manages an uptime heartbeat in Phare. A heartbeat expects a ping from a cron job or a worker at a regular interval, and opens an incident once the missed or failed pings are confirmed. The job requests the `ping_url` with GET, HEAD or POST when it succeeds, with `/fail` appended when it fails, and can request it with `/start` appended when it begins to measure its run time, a started run must then finish within the `grace` period. The heartbeat stays `waiting` without any incident until its first ping.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "phare_uptime_heartbeat" "backup" {
  name         = "Nightly backup"
  display_name = "Backups" # Public name on status pages

  interval               = 86400 # Expect a ping every day
  grace                  = 1800  # Count a ping as missed 30 minutes after it was expected
  incident_confirmations = 1
  recovery_confirmations = 1
  tags                   = ["environment:production", "team:backend"]
}

# The ping URL is sensitive, anyone knowing it can report the job as successful
output "backup_ping_url" {
  value     = phare_uptime_heartbeat.backup.ping_url
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `grace` (Number) Time allowed after an expected ping before it counts as missed, in seconds, a whole number of minutes from 1 minute (`60`) to 7 days (`604800`)
- `incident_confirmations` (Number) Number of uninterrupted missed or failed pings required to create an incident (1-5)
- `interval` (Number) Expected time between two pings, in seconds, a whole number of minutes from 1 minute (`60`) to 31 days (`2678400`)
- `name` (String) Heartbeat name, unique in the project
- `recovery_confirmations` (Number) Number of uninterrupted successful pings required to resolve an incident (1-5)

### Optional

- `display_name` (String) Public name of the heartbeat on status pages, defaults to the heartbeat `name`
- `project_scope` (Dynamic) Optional. Project scope for this resource. Accepts either a numeric project ID (e.g., 123) or a string project slug (e.g., "my-project"). Overrides the provider-level project_scope if set. Required when using an organization-scoped API key (starting with pha_org_).
- `tags` (Set of String) Resource tags (max 20, each 1-100 characters, only letters, numbers and . _ : - characters)

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Date of creation
- `id` (Number) Heartbeat ID
- `paused` (Boolean) Whether the heartbeat is paused
- `ping_url` (String, Sensitive) URL to request with GET, HEAD or POST when the job succeeds, add `/start` when it begins and `/fail` to report a failure
- `project_id` (Number) Parent project ID
- `status` (String) Heartbeat status (`waiting`, `online`, `offline` or `paused`), `waiting` until its first ping
- `updated_at` (String) Date of last update
